key_insight: A helical pipe passively creates swirling flow that redistributes particles across the cross-section, making pneumatic conveying more uniform at moderate gas velocity.
engineering_relevance: This geometry can reduce particle stratification and overly fast particles without needing higher airflow, improving conveying efficiency and wear control.
method: Comparison of straight pipe vs. helical pipe transport
Assessment of particle redistribution and velocity distributions
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a shift from heterogeneous transport in a straight pipe to a more homogeneous state with a narrower particle-velocity distribution in the helical pipe.
watch_item: The benefit may depend on pipe curvature, operating conditions, and added pressure-loss or installation complexity.
paper_title: Helical pipes homogenize particle transport in pneumatic conveying
